title: Vinícius Júnior Benched in Crucial Real Madrid Match
seoTitle: Vinícius Júnior Benched in Crucial Real Madrid Match
subtitle: After a series of underperforming displays, the Brazilian will not start against Villarreal.
excerpt: Forward Vinícius Júnior will not start for Real Madrid against Villarreal. José Mourinho has benched him after a series of poor performances for both club and national.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Forward Vinícius Júnior will not be among Real Madrid's starters in Saturday's clash against Villarreal. Head coach José Mourinho's decision to bench the Brazilian, described as bold, has sparked discussions and is the main reason the topic is trending.

José Mourinho's Choice

José Mourinho, in his return to the Bernabéu, made the decision to bench Vinícius Júnior in the team's first match after the September-October international break. The Portuguese opted to field Yan Diomande in place of the Brazilian on the left wing, while Arda Güler commands the right. Kylian Mbappé leads the attacking line, and Jude Bellingham maintains his role as the team's number 10.

The match against Villarreal is considered a fundamental game for Real Madrid, who are looking to recover from a “terrible” defeat in the Madrid derby. The team, 15-time European champions, is nine points behind leaders Barcelona after just seven games this season.

The Forward's Recent Performances

Mourinho's decision comes after a series of what are considered weak performances from Vinícius Júnior, both for the club and the national team. The Brazilian player has scored only one goal in his first eight appearances for Real Madrid this season and was substituted early in games against Elche and Atlético de Madrid.

For the Brazilian national team, the performance was no different. Vinícius Júnior found the net only once from a penalty in three matches. His display against India was so unsatisfactory that coach Carlo Ancelotti took him off at halftime.

Possible Reasons for the Absence

In addition to the below-par performance, Mourinho might have considered the fact that Vinícius Júnior accumulated many minutes on the field during the international break and had to travel back to Spain from India. Other players who were expected to start, such as Marc Cucurella and Denzel Dumfries, are also on the bench.

However, Vinícius Júnior's “self-declared” difficulties are impossible to ignore. The measure could be a “wake-up call” for the forward to regain his best form, at the risk of Yan Diomande consolidating his position on the left wing.

Real Madrid's Outlook

Real Madrid takes to the field needing a victory to regain confidence. The team faces Villarreal looking to reverse the situation after the derby defeat. The starting lineup for the match includes Courtois; Alexander-Arnold, Konaté, Rüdiger, Carreras; Tchouaméni, Valverde; Güler, Bellingham, Diomande; Mbappé. The substitutes are Andriy Lunin, Sergio Mestre, Denzel Dumfries, Marc Cucurella, Bernardo Silva, Eduardo Camavinga, Thiago Pitarch, Brahim Díaz, Carlos Espí, Endrick, and Vinícius Júnior.

With information from Sports Illustrated.
